selection.ownership: Anchor Browser, Inc. is a US-headquartered (New York) cloud browser automation company with a Tel Aviv engineering presence. Default infrastructure is AWS us-east-2. The reviewed edition is api.anchorbrowser.io, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Anchor Browser API authentication (anchor-api-key), GET /v1/billing, GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/metadata from pinned source, US/NYC identity, Trust Portal, and dated incident search (Anchor Browser + anchorbrowser.io + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Rankiteo recorded 0 incidents for Anchor Browser. Unrelated UK care-provider and podcasting-platform 'Anchor' incidents were excluded.

Official Anchor Browser API at https://api.anchorbrowser.io, API keys from app.anchorbrowser.io, US NYC operator with US data residency, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying customer-account compromise found in reviewed coverage, without a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /v1/billing, the cheap authenticated billing-balance read used by the pinned validator. POST /v1/sessions is omitted as a billed write. Native omits the upstream user-agent and optional billing usage query (from_date/to_date/granularity) because the pinned get_billing_info action has an empty input schema.
Returns raw Anchor Browser JSON under data. Official optional usage-window query parameters are omitted because the pinned get_billing_info action has an empty input schema.

projectId is URL-encoded as a path segment on GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/metadata, matching the pinned executor. Current public API index emphasizes applications and billing; this project-metadata path is retained from the pinned source rather than guessed as GET /v1/applications.

Official copy is POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/copy with an empty JSON body.

Composio format/wait/new_page/page_index map to POST /v1/tools/fetch-webpage. sessionId is sent as a query parameter. This is distinct from Web Unlocker POST /v1/tools/fetch/webpage.
Official list is GET /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/agent/files.
Official list is GET /v1/extensions.
Official list is GET /v1/integrations.
Official list is GET /v1/profiles.

Official list is GET /v1/sessions (sessions history page).
Official legacy executions list is GET /v1/task/{taskId}/executions. page/limit/status/version are query parameters.
Official legacy list is GET /v1/task. Optional page and limit are query parameters.
Official legacy versions list is GET /v1/task/{taskId}/versions.
Official move is POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/mouse/move with JSON x and y.
Official navigate is POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/goto with JSON {url}.
Official paste is POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/paste with JSON {text}.

Official shortcut is POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/keyboard/shortcut with JSON {keys}. Optional hold_time is forwarded when present.
Official perform-web-task is POST /v1/tools/perform-web-task. sessionId is sent as a query parameter; remaining Composio fields go in the JSON body.
Official mouse-down is POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/mouse/down.

Composio run-task fields match legacy POST /v1/task/run (taskId in the JSON body), not POST /v2/tasks/{taskId}/run.
Official legacy run-by-name is POST /v1/task/run/{taskName}.
Official screenshot tool is POST /v1/tools/screenshot. sessionId is a query parameter; remaining fields are JSON body. The live response may be image/png; fixtures pin a JSON envelope.
Official scroll is POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/scroll with x, y, and deltaY.
Official set-clipboard is POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/clipboard with JSON {text}.
Official signal is POST /v1/events/{event_name} with JSON {data}.
Official start is POST /v1/sessions. Optional Composio browser/session/identities/integrations objects are forwarded as JSON.
Official session screenshot is GET /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/screenshot. The live response may be image/png; fixtures pin a JSON envelope.
Official type is POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/keyboard/type with JSON {text, delay}.

Official docs expose create/list/get/delete only. Composio UPDATE_PROFILE (name + session_id) is mapped to POST /v1/profiles, the documented create-from-session endpoint that stores profile data when the session ends.
Official legacy update is PUT /v1/task/{taskId} with optional name and description.
Official upload is POST /v1/extensions as multipart/form-data. Declarative JSON cannot send files, so this operation is handwritten.
Official upload is POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/agent/files as multipart/form-data. Handwritten because declarative JSON cannot send files.
Official upload is POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/uploads as multipart/form-data field file. Handwritten because declarative JSON cannot send files.
Official wait is POST /v1/events/{event_name}/wait. Optional timeoutMs is JSON body.
